editorial.name: V7 Go
editorial.descriptionZh: V7 Go 把尽调、核保、理赔这类文档密集流程做成 AI 工作流，主要卖给私募、保险与地产。首页几乎全黑，只留一段衬线大字和一句加粗说明。
editorial.takeawayZh: 整屏留黑，只放一段衬线大字和一行粗体说明
editorial.noteZh: 进去是一屏纯黑，顶部一条细横幅写 Due Diligence Automation: Moderne Ventures x V7 Go，后面跟 Watch Video →。导航只有 Product / Solutions / Resources / Company 与 Login / Watch Keynote / Get in Touch，左上是 V7 字标。首屏正中是白色衬线大字 Complex workflows. Zero room for error.，副标把 V7 automates complex, document-heavy workflows across private markets, insurance and real estate, from investment diligence and reporting to submission ingestion and underwriting 里的三个行业名和两类流程加粗，整屏只有一颗 Book a demo 按钮，下面一行小字 Shaping the future of investment intelligence。再往下按行业分块：Private Markets 下列 Deal screening / Due Diligence / Investment Memos / Portfolio Reporting，Insurance 下列 Submission Ingestion / Underwriting / Triage / Policy Review / Claims Processing，第三块是 Real Estate Investment；客户证言里摆着 21x faster processing. 54% fewer errors.。
editorial.pricing: unknown（首页只有 Book a demo 与 Get in Touch，未列价格；站内有 /pricing 页）

reasons.statement: 首屏交付的是 V7 自己的行业分块、用例清单与 demo 入口，用户拿走的是全黑留白配衬线大字这一版排版；来自 saaslandingpage.com 的落地页灵感池，故归产品与公司官网。
导航为 Product / Solutions / Resources / Company 加 Login / Watch Keynote / Get in Touch，路径集中在 /ai-for-finance、/ai-for-insurance、/ai-for-real-estate 等产品页，是 B2B 产品门面。
